body:
What you are looking for is the searchFunction hook which is a global hook of the instantsearch({searchHook}).

The query hook is only called when the user actually type something.

Those are two differents hooks because if you want to implement a query debouncing, you need the hook to be on the searchBox widget. But if you want to be able to globally hack all requests made then you need the global searchFunction hook.

See the all options tab for the instantsearch function in the documentation
